summary.text: Pierina Sanchez represents the 14th District on the New York City Council, which includes Kingsbridge, Fordham, University Heights and Mount Hope in the Bronx.
Her Council biography describes a career that includes the Obama White House, the Regional Plan Association and an advisory role in the mayor's office.

paragraphs.text: Sanchez was born and raised in the Bronx, the daughter of immigrants, and attended P.S. 46, M.S. 45 and the Academy of Mount Saint Ursula, according to her Council biography.
She graduated from Harvard University on a full scholarship and earned a Master in Public Affairs degree from Princeton University.
She began her public service career in the summer of 2007, worked at Agenda for Children Tomorrow, and after college worked in the Council District 14 office.

She served in the Obama White House and later as an urban planner at the Regional Plan Association, and was a member of Bronx Community Board 5 and co-founder of the Jerome Avenue Revitalization Collaborative.
Most recently before the Council she was an advisor in the mayor's office, then a Senior Fellow at the Pratt Center for Community Development.
